skill.name: blogwatcher
skill.description: Monitor blogs and RSS/Atom feeds for updates using the blogwatcher CLI.
skill.body:
# blogwatcher

Track blog and RSS/Atom feed updates with the `blogwatcher` CLI.

Install
- Go: `go install github.com/Hyaxia/blogwatcher/cmd/blogwatcher@latest`

Quick start
- `blogwatcher --help`

Common commands
- Add a blog: `blogwatcher add "My Blog" https://example.com`
- List blogs: `blogwatcher blogs`
- Scan for updates: `blogwatcher scan`
- List articles: `blogwatcher articles`
- Mark an article read: `blogwatcher read 1`
- Mark all articles read: `blogwatcher read-all`
- Remove a blog: `blogwatcher remove "My Blog"`

Example output
```
$ blogwatcher blogs
Tracked blogs (1):

  xkcd
    URL: https://xkcd.com
```
```
$ blogwatcher scan
Scanning 1 blog(s)...

  xkcd
    Source: RSS | Found: 4 | New: 4

Found 4 new article(s) total!
```

Notes
- Use `blogwatcher <command> --help` to discover flags and options.

generated_query: I’ve been following a few tech blogs and RSS feeds manually, but I keep missing updates. Could you help me set up a simple workflow to track them? I want to add my favorite blogs by URL—like “xkcd” from https://xkcd.com and “Daring Fireball” from https://daringfireball.net/feed—then check for new posts whenever I remember. After scanning, I’d like to see a list of the new articles and mark each one as read after I read it, or mark all as read if I’ve caught up. Also, if I stop following a blog, I need to remove it from the list. Can you walk me through the commands step by step?

edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the scan command removes the core ability to check for new posts, so the user cannot detect updates.
